purpose: Common behavioural test design for baseline calibration and experimental comparison using the same trusted baseline Python and common tests, with descriptive G2 evidence profiles.
oracle_policy: Expected outcomes may be omitted and derived from the accepted trusted baseline Python; the same test cases are then applied to generated Python.
g2_policy: The G2 headline classification is accompanied by per-suite evidence_summary, six coverage dimensions, coverage_basis, limitations and interpretation guidance; runtime scoring adds declared/evaluable/pass counts and execution-derived evidence.

deterministic_seed_policy.note: Fixed seeds are research controls, not correctness criteria.

compatibility_note: Test Design v1.1 and its 113 executable test cases are unchanged; v4.29 retains v4.28 reference-execution corrections and adds explicit optional external-module lowering for Algorithm 50; test semantics remain unchanged.
